description: This file implements functions for managing module interface mappings within an advanced networking service container. It provides functions to add, delete, and query interface objects associated with a module container object, facilitating dynamic management of network interfaces.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscMcoAddModuleIf(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * pIfName,ANSC_HANDLE hInterface)
methods.description: Adds an interface mapping to the module container object by delegating to the internal query interface's AddIf method.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscMcoDelModuleIf(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * pIfName)
methods.description: Deletes an interface mapping from the module container object by delegating to the internal query interface's DelIf method.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscMcoQueryModuleIf(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * pIfName)
methods.description: Retrieves an interface object associated with the given interface name by delegating to the internal query interface's QueryIf method.
